desc: Derive the exact zero-safe update identity \(Z' = Z+(y-x)P_vS_v\).
Verify that the current direct-DP program passes both public samples.
Investigate an always-invertible augmented representation of singular column transfers for a zero-safe moving-cut algorithm; it remains too slow in balanced grids.

Derive a concrete zero-safe directed-planar boundary-response algorithm for the complement of a connected set of \(B\) mutable grid cells, with construction time \(O(HW+B^2)\), or rigorously demonstrate why this response cannot be obtained within that bound.
Prove that, given the compressed boundary-response DAG, each mutable-cell value update can be evaluated in \(O(B)\) time including zero weights.
Establish the complete square-root batching complexity, including balanced and highly unbalanced grids such as \(2\times200000\).

Investigate a dynamic planar-DAG/grid partition-function algorithm using separators or Schur complements that supports arbitrary zero vertex weights and prove a full worst-case bound suitable for \(HW,Q\le2\cdot10^5\).
Derive a sublinear dynamic representation for products of the special lower-triangular column transfers, or prove the relevant rank/interface growth prevents this approach.
Replace the \(O(HWQ)\) fallback with a rigorously bounded full-constraint algorithm and implement it in Python.
